sourceSentences: [0] Alistar is quite useless at level one so you should abuse that
[0] it's very important to not stand on your ADC as you can hit Q on the both of you
[0] because of his W you can never eat in unless he has used it first if you do he will knock you very deep in far away from ad carry and then proceed to Perma CCU
